title: NuSAP1 promotes spindle assembly in Trypanosoma brucei by bundling spindle microtubules
task: Characterize NuSAP1's role in spindle assembly and mitotic regulation in T. brucei
key_results: NuSAP1 bundles microtubules in vitro; NuSAP1 depletion disrupts spindle assembly and kinetochore biorientation; NuSAP1 regulates stability of NuSAP4 and localization of SPB1 to spindle poles
comments: The mechanistic insights into parasite-specific spindle regulation may reveal therapeutic targets, though the unusual intranuclear spindle architecture limits direct mammalian cell applicability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NuSAP1 is required for spindle pole complex assembly
hypotheses.result: NuSAP1 knockdown disrupts localization of MAP103 and TbMlp2 to spindle poles

hypotheses.hypothesis: NuSAP1 bundles spindle microtubules to promote spindle assembly
hypotheses.result: NuSAP1 bundles microtubules in vitro; depletion disrupts spindle assembly in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: NuSAP1 interacts with and regulates NuSAP4 and SPB1
hypotheses.result: NuSAP1 regulates NuSAP4 stability and SPB1 localization through distinct structural motifs

title: Improving arrhythmic risk prediction using cardiac magnetic resonance within deep learning in ischemic heart disease
task: Arrhythmic risk prediction in ischemic heart disease using deep learning survival models
key_results: Scar entropy emerged as strongest predictor; DeepSurv achieved superior cross-cohort generalization compared to Cox regression and Random Survival Forests
comments: Promising application of deep survival models to cardiac imaging, though clinical utility requires validation against current standard risk stratification in prospective trials.

inputs: LGE-CMR features (scar burden, scar entropy, heterogeneity)

hypotheses.hypothesis: LGE-CMR features provide incremental prognostic value beyond conventional markers like LVEF
hypotheses.result: Supported; scar entropy identified as strong predictor complementing clinical variables

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-linear machine learning approaches outperform Cox regression for arrhythmic risk
hypotheses.result: Supported; DeepSurv and Random Survival Forests showed superior performance with better generalization
